about: Supplier (8), wrong number (5), other (6) and outbound (10) skeletons. On supplier, wrong-number and other calls the other party is not a customer: no voice is applied to their lines (party != customer). Outbound calls are transcribed and never judged; they open with the other party's hello and the advisor's moves.outbound_open. Outbound reasons and shares follow DESIGN.md section 2: car ready 35 %, approval of found work 25 %, calling a missed caller back 18 %, supplier 12 %, confirming a booking 10 %.
